stories.title: Veteran councillor suspended by party after 'social media communication'
stories.summary: Belfast councillor Jim Rogers has been suspended by the Ulster Unionist Party pending the outcome of a “disciplinary process”.

stories.title: Senior PSNI officer arrested over alleged sexual assault
stories.summary: The 47-year-old man was detained in Belfast on Monday, following a complaint made by a woman.

stories.title: SDLP meeting changes venue after 'intimidation'
stories.summary: The original meeting was due to take place in a venue on the Newtownards Road in east Belfast.

stories.title: School offers prizes to pupils for turning up to class on day GTA 6 comes out
stories.summary: Belfast Boys' Model school issued letters to parents, saying that the release of the game on Thursday coincided with GCSE maths exams.

stories.title: Rail services and discounts are hit in Translink cutbacks
stories.summary: Late-night train services in Northern Ireland are to be reduced and some fare discounts are to be lowered as part of new cost-cutting measures.

stories.title: What could Milburn's Neets review mean for Northern Ireland?
stories.summary: While the focus of the report is overwhelmingly on England, important changes are likely to apply in NI.

stories.title: UK government declines Stormont Brake for second time
stories.summary: Unionist parties asked the Secretary of State to use the post-Brexit mechanism to block updated EU customs rules from applying in NI.

stories.title: Taoiseach 'not contemplating' separate Omagh bombing inquiry
stories.summary: Taoiseach (Irish prime minister) Michéal Martin said the British government's examination must be allowed to conclude.

stories.title: Man admits unlawfully killing Karen Cummings
stories.summary: The 40-year-old was found unconscious with a serious head injury in December 2024.

stories.title: School orchestra cuts penalise young people in rural areas, says principal
stories.summary: More than 2,000 young musicians have been told that transport to take part in bands and orchestras is being withdrawn.

stories.title: NI only part of UK to see increase in employment
stories.summary: The number of workers on company payrolls in NI in October 1% higher than the same time last year at 822,800.

stories.title: Nursing union 'dissatisfied' with safe staffing legislation
stories.summary: Health Minister Robbie Butler introduced the Health and Social Care (Staffing) bill in the assembly on Monday.
